dslRule:
<!id: method.visibility.to.packagePrivate>
<!description: Changes a specific private method to package-private.
   This is typically done to allow access from other classes within the same package
   without exposing it to the entire module or requiring a public API.
   Based on bug 308898 fix where activeJavaEditorChanged needed to be called from ClassFileEditor.>
<!severity: HINT>

private void $name($params$) :: methodNameMatches($name, "activeJavaEditorChanged")
=>
void $name($params$)
;;
summary: Transforms a specific private method `activeJavaEditorChanged` to have package-private visibility.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
